text: I went to grief counselling, which helped me separate the vision from my husband's real death, which was quick and in a hospital. My counsellor encouraged me to return to the coast, which I did after a year, and I was able to stand by the water and talk to him. My daughter and I have slowly repaired things. I haven't spoken to the friend since.
Ich habe eine Verhaltenstherapie gemacht mit schrittweiser Konfrontation. Erst volle Läden, dann Bahn, dann kleine Konzerte. Das hilft. Große Konzerte gehe ich noch nicht.

I couldn't talk to my parents about it, and I couldn't go to a regular therapist at first because I was afraid they'd think I was crazy or that I'd be 'judged' for the religious stuff. Eventually I found a therapist who specialises in religious trauma. That was the turning point. She helped me understand that the possession experience was the LSD interacting with beliefs I'd absorbed as a child, and that my parents' reaction, though well-meant, was traumatic in itself.

I've been in therapy for two years. I've also joined an online community of people who've left strict religious groups, which has helped me feel less alone. I've told my parents the truth now. My mother cried. My father still believes it was a demon.

The fear has mostly gone. I can look in mirrors at night. But I don't think I'll ever take psychedelics again.
Ich war beim Neurologen, der alles abgeklärt hat. Mit der Zeit wurde es besser.

My parents sent me to a counsellor for a few months, which at the time felt like punishment but actually helped. I talked a lot with one of the other girls who was there that night, we became close friends. As an adult I did a year of therapy for anxiety, which helped me connect a lot of my perfectionism to that experience.

Ich bin zu meiner Schwester gezogen, weil ich nicht allein sein konnte. Sie hat mich zu einer Psychiaterin gebracht, die mir ein Antidepressivum verschrieben hat. Danach habe ich eine Psychotherapie begonnen, in der ich die Trauer um meinen Hund und die Trennung bearbeitet habe. Es hat lange gedauert. Ein Jahr später habe ich einen neuen Hund aus dem Tierheim geholt, das war schwer, aber gut. Ich gehe inzwischen wieder in den Wald, aber nur mit Leine und nie allein bei Dämmerung. Die Schuldgefühle sind noch nicht ganz weg.

I saw a cardiologist several times, who confirmed my heart is healthy, which helped a little. My GP prescribed propranolol for the physical symptoms, which helped, and later sertraline. I did a course of CBT for panic disorder, which was the most helpful thing: learning about the panic cycle and doing interoceptive exposure, like running up stairs on purpose to make my heart race and seeing that nothing bad happens. I've gradually gone back to the gym. I still have panic attacks occasionally, but I'm not afraid of them in the same way. What didn't help: the first few ER visits where doctors were dismissive, and an urgent care doctor who gave me benzodiazepines without explaining anything, which I then became a bit dependent on and had to taper off.
I talked to a therapist a few times about the guilt. My mum and I eventually had a long conversation and she forgave me. My brother doesn't really remember much of it.

Ich war beim Augenarzt und beim Neurologen, beide ohne Befund. Ein Psychiater hat mir Clonazepam gegeben, was die Angst kurzfristig gedämpft hat, aber ich wollte es nicht dauerhaft nehmen. In einer Online-Gruppe für HPPD habe ich Tipps bekommen, z.B. Sonnenbrille tragen, Stress reduzieren, kein Cannabis. Das hilft ein bisschen. Am meisten hat mir geholfen, dass ich mich daran gewöhnt habe und nicht mehr ständig darauf achte. Trotzdem stört es mich immer noch, vor allem abends.
Told my best friend everything. We laughed about it eventually.
